notes.title: Trading Cards and other neat stuff - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://bit.ly/1a3qzgC[/img]

Trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds and emoticons, we have them all... and they are available to collect as you play Keebles.

There are 7 trading cards featuring the fauna and flora around Keeble Island, with notes from intrepid explorer Sir Reginald E Keeble as he wandered around the island.

You can see what's available to trade or buy [url=http://steamcommunity.com/market/search?q=keebles]on the Community market now[/url].

We also have a total of 6 badges, including 1 foil badge, 5 emoticons and 5 profile backgrounds.

Happy Keebling!

notes.title: Burnt Fuse Plays Keebles
notes.notes:
To celebrate the launch of Keebles, we will be taking a victory lap of Keebles and live streaming a casual playthrough on our Twitch channel:

[url=http://www.twitch.tv/burntfusegames]http://www.twitch.tv/burntfusegames[/url]

Broadcast times:
7:00pm UTC (London)
3:00pm EDT (New York)
12:00pm PDT (San Francisco)
6:00am AEDT (Melbourne)

CAUTION: HERE BE SPOILERS

We won't be doing a speed or a completion run (unless issued the proper challenge in 3 languages), it will be just us enjoying ourselves after 2 years of hard labour.

Felix, the level designer, will be doing the main driving and he hasn't touched the game much in the last 2 weeks. He's played through the game over 5 times now but can never remember how he played it the last time. This should be interesting.

Please do drop by and say Hi. Feel free to ask us any questions you have... or just make fun of us. We exist for your entertainment pleasure.

Happy Keebling!

Felix & Gavin

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CBGDM3vUIAAJ5dh.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.keeblesgame.com/presskit/keebles/images/screenshot-1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: GamersFTW Keebles review - 7/10
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.gamersftw.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/panda_11.png[/img]

GamersFTW has played right through all 30 levels of Keebles and has given it 7/10.

[i]"Keebles is a physics-based vehicle-building puzzle game which marks the first game by Australian Indie developer Burnt Fuse. The game requires you to build a range of wacky contraptions in order to save a race of small fur balls and make it to the end of the world. Trial and error is the key to this game requiring you to firstly perfect a vehicle capable of traversing the environment and secondly guide it to the goal through the use of your gadgets."[/i]


Check the full review out here:

[url=http://www.gamersftw.co.uk/keebles-review]http://www.gamersftw.co.uk/keebles-review[/url]

GamersFTW has played right through all 30 levels of Keebles and has given it 7/10.

[i]"Keebles is a physics-based vehicle-building puzzle game which marks the first game by Australian Indie developer Burnt Fuse. The game requires you to build a range of wacky contraptions in order to save a race of small fur balls and make it to the end of the world. Trial and error is the key to this game requiring you to firstly perfect a vehicle capable of traversing the environment and secondly guide it to the goal through the use of your gadgets."[/i]


Check the full review out here:

[url=http://www.gamersftw.co.uk/keebles-review]http://www.gamersftw.co.uk/keebles-review[/url]

notes.title: Playfire - Keebles Developer Interview
notes.notes:
[img]http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-a4AMTSm6lr0/VPm1K4VKATI/AAAAAAAAAOE/I7SHgLfm_YI/s1600/SpotlightOn_Blog_Banner.jpg[/img]

As the beta release of Keebles goes live, Playfire sat down with us to chat about all thing Keebles, Bobbles and Boom Boom Pods. We tell things we have never told another soul before. Check it out!

"We're enormously excited about Keebles. The second game to come from the Green Man Loaded label, Burnt Fuse's inventive, vehicle-building puzzler is shaping up very nicely indeed, and will be playable on the show floor at EGX Rezzed!

We know that a bunch of you have been eager to know more about the game, so we sat down recently with the developers to talk about how the game came about, the range of vehicles players will be able to build, and what EGX Rezzed attendees can expect from the playable build that'll be at the show."


[url=http://blog.playfire.com/2015/03/keebles-interview-rezzed-spotlight.html]
http://blog.playfire.com/2015/03/keebles-interview-rezzed-spotlight.html[/url]
